title: 7S.3 DWG per-entity frame checkpoint
scope: Generated fast implementation slice replacing document-wide snapshots on ordinary entity writes with a bounded frame checkpoint.
changes: Added an entity-frame checkpoint for byte length, object-map length, sticky error flags, and DWG object-frame provenance.
Added bounded rollback for the current frame's object-map publication and owner/INSERT memberships; retained full compound snapshots for class-associated handles and larger transaction boundaries.
Extended the existing block-owner membership selector to assert ordinary entity encoding performs no full checkpoint and to exercise frame publication and owner-index rollback.
